title: Fix for markdown equation formatting
description: I was having similar issues to those reported in https://github.com/quarto-dev/jupyterlab-quarto/issues/7 and https://github.com/quarto-dev/jupyterlab-quarto/issues/3 , and dug in a bit to see what the problem was. I found that the way the MutationObserver architecture was set up for triggering MathJax.typesetPromise did not match the DOM layout I was getting from jupyterlab. I'm not sure why this seems to be different for different users - presumably an underlying jupyterlab reason. I rewrote the architecture so that it should be much less fragile to changes in the document structure, and this seems to resolve the issue.
